card: Bitcoin Core currently cannot detect whether the host environment lacks IPv4 or IPv6 global routing, leading nodes on IPv4-only hosts to waste resources and AddrMan slots on futile outbound IPv6 connection attempts. This pull request adds periodic reachability checks using UDP route lookups without transmitting packets, dynamically marking IPv4 or IPv6 unreachable if no route exists. Inactive networks are excluded from automatic outbound connections and AddrMan additions until connectivity is restored. Author notes that in many environments IPv6 peers cannot be reached and futile connection attempts occur continuously.
evidence: PR description: "In many network environments, IPv6 peers cannot be reached, which is currently not detected. As a result, IPv6 addresses take up spots in AddrMan, and we make futile attempts to connect to them (e.g. feelers or network-specific connections)."
problem: Nodes hosted in environments lacking IPv6 connectivity (or rarely, lacking IPv4 connectivity) do not detect this limitation and continuously attempt futile outbound connections, such as feelers, to unreachable peers. These unreachable addresses also occupy slots in AddrMan and consume connection attempt cycles.

risk.why: A false positive in route detection would erroneously mark IPv4 or IPv6 unreachable, cutting off outbound connections to an entire address family.

scope_notes: The implementation relies on operating system socket behavior when calling connect() on unbound UDP sockets to check routing tables without sending packets.
summary: Adds automatic detection of IPv4 and IPv6 network reachability using UDP connect route lookups without sending packets over the wire. If the operating system reports no usable global route for one network protocol while another is functional, the unreachable network is removed from reachable networks. This check runs one minute after startup and repeats every ten minutes, adjusting outbound connection attempts and address manager updates accordingly.
uncertainties: Diff was not provided in the prompt to verify socket error handling and platform-specific connect semantics.
